name: Stone Sculpture · Death
primary: The shape you drew yourself in a 5×5×5 cube (press K for the shape editor): it is built at the aim point and turns to follow your view; can hang in mid-air without support. Material: magic earth, permanent.
self_description:
The shape you drew yourself in a 5×5×5 cube (press K for the shape editor): it is built at the aim point and turns to follow your view; can hang in mid-air without support. Material: magic earth, permanent. On you:
